headline.purpose: Page and drawer titles — louder telemetry, same monospace voice.

data.purpose: The workhorse: tables, badges, metadata. Most of any screen.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked section labels and column headers, in Muted gray.

motion.name: duration-enter
motion.purpose: Entrance animations (slide-over, toast). Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single cyan action key — instrument-press feedback, one per view section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.609 0.126 221.723); color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.655 0.127 221.723); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — bordered, transparent, quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #d1d5db; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #4b5563; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Terminal well input — dark field, gray stroke, cyan focus shift (no ring, no glow).
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="URL or hostname to test" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #0a0b0f; border: 1px solid #374151; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e5e7eb; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.609 0.126 221.723); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #4b5563; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status lamp — tinted fill at ~15%, full-strength status color as text. Semantics fixed everywhere.
components.html: completed failed partial running
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.12); color: #4ade80; } .ds-badge-failure { background: rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.12); color: #f87171; } .ds-badge-attention { background: rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.12); color: #fbbf24; } .ds-badge-inflight { background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.12); color: #22d3ee; }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Uppercase tracked micro-heading that rules every data section.
components.css: .ds-section-label { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9ca3af; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The primary layout organism — hairline-ruled container, Surface header, 12px mono rows.
components.css: .ds-table-container { border: 1px solid #1a1b25; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; background: #0a0b0f; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-table th { background: #0d0e14; color: #9ca3af; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; text-align: left; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-table td { color: #d1d5db; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 8px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #1a1b25; } .ds-table tbody tr { transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #12131a; } .ds-td-ok { color: #4ade80; } .ds-td-fail { color: #f87171; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar rail item — gray at rest, cyan when active with an inset left bar.
components.html: DashboardURL ProbeRuns
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #0f1015; padding: 8px; width: 180px; } .ds-nav-item { font-family: 'Cascadia Code', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #9ca3af; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: #e5e7eb; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #22d3ee; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #22d3ee; background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.06); }

narrative.overview: LagHound's interface is a premium terminal where the data itself is the light source. Everything is dark glass — near-black layered surfaces with thin borders instead of shadows — and the only things that glow are signals: phosphor-cyan interactions, green/red/amber status lamps, white-hot numbers. Monospace type everywhere gives the whole product the confidence of a tool built by engineers for engineers; nothing is decorated, everything is calibrated. Density is a feature: the workhorse type size is 12px monospace, and controls behave like tactile instrument keys — crisp edges, a 1px press on click, a border shift on focus.
keyCharacteristics: Dark glass surfaces, flat: depth from four background steps + 1px borders, never shadows
Monospace-first at every level, 12px data type as the default voice
One interactive accent (Phosphor Cyan); brand violet reserved for the mark
Semantically fixed status colors, identical everywhere
Tactile instrument-key controls: press feedback, focus border shifts, 150–200ms motion

rules.name: The Logo-Only Violet Rule
rules.body: Brand Violet appears only in the mark and brand assets — never on statuses, KPIs, buttons, or charts.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Phosphor Cyan is the only interactive accent. If a second accent seems needed, the answer is hierarchy, not a new color.

rules.name: The Status Semantics Rule
rules.body: Green = success, red = failure, amber = attention/partial, cyan = in-flight, grey = inert — identically in every table, badge, chart, and report.

rules.name: The Data-First Rule
rules.body: 12px monospace is the default voice; larger sizes are the exception and must earn their space.

rules.name: The Borders-Not-Shadows Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separation, step its background one token and rule it with Hairline #1a1b25. A shadow is never the answer.

rules.name: The AA Floor Rule
rules.body: Meaningful text never drops below 4.5:1 on its background: Muted #9ca3af is the workhorse, Faint #6b7280 the de-emphasis floor. Only placeholders and disabled states may go dimmer (#4b5563).

dos: Do set data in 12px monospace and let density carry the design; every pixel should communicate information.
Do use the four-step background stack + 1px Hairline borders for all separation and depth.
Do keep status colors semantically exact everywhere (green/red/amber/cyan/grey), including reports and charts.
Do give every control press feedback (1px translate) and a 150ms border/fill transition — tactile, not animated.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every entrance animation.
Do keep muted text at gray-400 (#9ca3af) or brighter for anything a user must read.
donts: Don't use Brand Violet outside the logo/brand mark (Logo-Only Violet Rule).
Don't add box-shadows, gradients, or glassmorphism — flat surfaces and borders only.
Don't introduce a second interactive accent or re-purpose a status color decoratively.
Don't put gray text on colored fills — use white/near-white or a darker shade of the fill.
Don't disable a control without disabled styling; a dead-looking-alive button is a bug.
